headline.note: noisy = 1x device-mismatch model (per-device VTO 10mV + BETA 0.5%) + read noise; 3 chips each 0.9694 test accuracy at a fixed 30-epoch budget (evaluated at the endpoint, epoch 30), mean 0.9694
headline.stopping: clean run reported at the endpoint of its fixed 15-epoch budget (0.9806); noisy runs reported at the endpoint of a fixed 30-epoch budget (0.9694 each)

network.structure: 64 pixel inputs x 20 output rails (10 classes x {+,-}), differential readout: score_c = V(rail c+) - V(rail c-)
network.device: NMOS, drain at the pixel node, source at the rail, gate = learned weight (referenced to ground), body tied to the drain node

training.rule: per-sample contrastive coupled learning, strict SGD: free solve -> multiclass hinge -> clamp true/rival rail pairs by +-delta/2 -> contrastive gate update
training.init: vg ~ Uniform(0.5, 4.5) V, seed 0, clip [0.4, 8.0] V
training.data: seed-0 stratified 80/20 split (1437 train / 360 test), pixels scaled to [0,1] V and applied directly as node voltages (no front-end)
training.simulator: end-to-end ngspice .op solves (training, evaluation, and inference all in-circuit)

noise_model.device_mismatch: 1x model: per-device VTO offset (sigma 10 mV) AND per-device BETA/kp strength multiplier 1+eps (sigma 0.5%); free/clamp are electrically separate copies with independent devices (2E rule); a chip = its fingerprint (vto_free/vto_clamp + beta_free/beta_clamp), shipped as chip_1/2/3.npz
noise_model.read_noise: Gaussian sigma = 5 mV (0.5% of the 1.0 V input full scale) on every measurement, training AND inference
noise_model.protocol: noisy training with noisy per-epoch evaluation; fixed 30-epoch budget, reported at the endpoint (epoch 30)

runs.archive_format: vg_final (endpoint gates), vg0/acc0 (untrained baseline), acc_epochs (per-epoch test acc), endpoint acc (at15 clean / at30 noisy), drain/source; noisy archives also carry the chip fingerprint (vto_*/beta_*)
runs.inference_note: deployment inference (5 fresh-read draws at the endpoint gates) reproducible via infer_scikit.py

curves.clean_per_update: updcurve_clean.npz — train_acc, train_loss, test_acc, test_loss after EVERY applied gate update (index 0 = untrained), plus epoch, sample; 3422 points; enough to reconstruct the full clean training curves
curves.chips_per_epoch: acc_epochs array inside each run_chip{1,2,3}_gates.npz (per-epoch test accuracy)
